description: TN-ITS Road Feature Data is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lantmäteriet. The data set contains a selection of changes to road data that have been recorded in the NVDB since the previous version. Change information is created on a daily basis. It focuses on phenomena that are important for road safety, such as permitted speed on the road. Coverage: SE. Its keywords include Road data, Vägdata. The listing shows 2019-04-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
